source: Kenneth R. French Data Library, Fama/French 3 factors (monthly)
license: Kenneth R. French Data Library (free for academic research use)
downloaded_at: 2026-11-09 (the date the file was first committed; the actual download date was not recorded at the time)
derived_by: data_ingestion.french_factors (monthly section of F-F_Research_Data_Factors.csv, dates as YYYYMM)

columns.Mkt-RF: excess return of the market, percent per month
columns.SMB: size factor (small minus big), percent per month
columns.HML: value factor (high minus low book-to-market), percent per month
columns.RF: one-month Treasury bill rate, percent per month

point_in_time: NOT point-in-time: the library revises its factor returns; this is the series as published on the verification date, not a real-time vintage.

verified_against_source.method: downloaded the library's zip again and compared every monthly row with this file
verified_against_source.result: all 1203 months identical in all four columns; no month only in one of them
verified_against_source.caveat: these digests are of the verification download, not of the original download, which was not kept
